title: payments.payment.failed v1
description: Emitted when a payment attempt fails. Derived from the REAL producer alebrije-mod-payments-go PublishPaymentFailed (outbox_publisher.go:117,122-126 and event_publisher.go:183,184-188). NOTE: the producer currently emits the LEGACY event_type 'payment.failed' as a FLAT field map (config.go:180); on adoption it must use this canonical name and wrap the fields under data.*, matching the sibling payments.payment.completed migration (ADR-31 §4.2). Source: alebrije-mod-payments-go (Go).

link_id.description: Payment link UUID that originated the failed attempt (outbox_publisher.go:123). Used as the outbox idempotency key (linkID.String()).

reason.description: Provider/processor failure reason string passed into PublishPaymentFailed (outbox_publisher.go:125, event_publisher.go:187).
